scope: A/B/C/D/E/F source review, minimal correction, synthetic verification and local commits only
decisions: F precedes the preview and tool integrations; no unrelated pendingForMain question-discovery product code is included.
A/B/C/D form one compilable reader/composer/protocol closure; no intermediate obsolete Maps or single-source protocol is restored.

F includes only the named synthetic regression foundations required by its exact suite. Some were already untracked or had schema/tool-catalog fixture corrections before F. They are not newly authored wholesale by this review.
E observer regression is extracted to tests/tool-service-observer.test.ts. The pre-existing untracked tests/main-process.test.ts remains untouched and uncommitted.
Review correction: constrain the native image popup to the image container at 250px panels; preserve native positioning and shared form content.
Review test corrections: conversationView 3 fixture; current text marker editor; real handle movement plus every-coordinate cancellation assertion; existing approval loader dependencies.
Do not include package-lock churn, branding, memory/platform changes, production data, installed app state or generated build archives.
